name: Mouseflow

evidence.replay: F02: primary category is website behavior analytics with replay and heatmaps; F17: DOM-based replay and click, scroll and geo maps
evidence.web: F15: page, referrer, device, location and campaign filters on recorded sessions

line: Records website sessions, heatmaps, funnels and visitor behavior.

free.text: Free: 500 sessions/mo, 1 site, unlimited users, 1mo history (as-is)

pv.math: Billed by sessions. The free plan covers 500 a month. Essential starts at €39 a month for 5,000 sessions.
